summary: All 3 items in the review (2 bug fixes + 1 rename) VERIFIED on Kasir Kita (offline Expo/AsyncStorage POS). BUG FIX 1 (CSV export always failed): PASS - on web, tapping 'Ekspor ke CSV / Excel' in Laporan triggers a real browser download event with filename 'laporan-harian.csv'; downloaded CSV content includes the required header row 'No Transaksi,Tanggal,Jumlah Item,Subtotal,Diskon,Total,Total Modal,Keuntungan,Dibayar,Kembalian,Status' and a valid data row (Rp19.000/Lunas). No 'Gagal mengekspor CSV' toast appears. BUG FIX 1b: PASS - Pengaturan 'Ekspor Data Barang (CSV)' triggers download 'data-barang.csv' with header 'Nama Barang,Kategori,Stok,Harga Modal,Harga Jual,Untung/unit' and seeded 8 product rows; no error toast. Code review of /app/frontend/src/utils/csv.ts confirms clean Platform.OS==='web' branch using Blob + URL.createObjectURL + anchor.click; native branch unchanged (File/Paths + Sharing.shareAsync). BUG FIX 2 (Bagikan): PASS - on web, tapping 'Bagikan' (testID receipt-share) on a Tunai receipt does NOT crash and shows the toast 'Fitur bagikan hanya tersedia di aplikasi HP (Android/iOS)'. captureRef succeeds (or the catch-block web guard triggers), Sharing.isAvailableAsync() returns false, and no red screen / no PAGEERROR / no Uncaught console errors are emitted. 'Cetak' (receipt-print) also does not crash. Code review of /app/frontend/app/receipt.tsx confirms receiptRef is attached to a <View collapsable={false}> so react-native-view-shot@4.0.3 can capture the card natively; on web the try/catch + Platform.OS==='web' guard produces the exact expected toast. RENAME: PASS - login brand shows 'Kasir Kita' (WarungPintar absent), Pengaturan footer shows 'Kasir Kita · Data tersimpan di HP ini' (WarungPintar absent), app.json name='Kasir Kita'. LIGHT REGRESSION: PASS - receipt card renders Total / Tunai / Kembalian rows; Laporan renders 'Keuntungan Bersih', 'Pendapatan Kotor', 'Total Modal' cards after the test transaction. No new deprecated-package or SafeAreaView issues detected beyond those previously reported.
critical_code_review_comments: csv.ts web branch is correct: uses Blob text/csv with BOM, createObjectURL, temporary anchor element, and revokes the URL - no memory leak.

receipt.tsx correctly wraps receiptRef with collapsable={false} which is required for react-native-view-shot to work on Android; format 'png' and result 'tmpfile' are appropriate defaults for Sharing.shareAsync with mimeType image/png.

handleShare has proper defense-in-depth: primary try captures ref + shares; catch has Platform.OS==='web' guard that shows the user-friendly toast, then falls back to shareReceipt PDF on native; final catch shows 'Gagal membagikan struk'. Robust and matches spec.
exportCSV on native path calls file.create() inside try/catch (idempotent when file already exists) then file.write() which will overwrite; ordering is correct.
Laporan and Pengaturan both wrap exportCSV in try/catch and show generic error toast only on throw - since the web branch now returns cleanly, no false-positive toast fires.
seed_data_creation: Cleared localStorage, created PIN 123456, auto-seeded 8 products loaded, made 1 Tunai transaction (Minyak Goreng Bimoli 1L, Rp19.000 total, Rp50.000 paid, Rp31.000 change, Lunas).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% offline (AsyncStorage). Fresh session shows 'Buat PIN Baru' - enter 123456 twice. Note: 'Bayar' (testID kasir-bayar-button) on Kasir tab navigates DIRECTLY to /checkout (Pembayaran) when there is exactly 1 item, bypassing the /cart screen; testID cart-checkout only exists on the standalone cart route. To reach the receipt from Kasir: tap product-card-* -> kasir-bayar-button -> checkout-quick-50000 (or fill checkout-paid-input) -> checkout-save. Tab bar has 2 DOM nodes per testID (accessibility duplicate) - the first is invisible; use JS click on the visible one (walk querySelectorAll and pick the one with rect.width>0). Playwright's page.expect_download() works for the web CSV export via anchor.click(). Native share sheet / WhatsApp integration cannot be verified on web preview - code review confirms native path is wired correctly.
rca_of_issue: N/A - both bugs were fixed by main agent in this iteration and verified working: (1) CSV export failed because expo-file-system File/Paths threw on web -> now guarded by Platform.OS==='web' branch that emits a Blob download. (2) Bagikan opened print flow because it called the PDF-print helper instead of capturing the card and calling Sharing.shareAsync -> now captures receiptRef via react-native-view-shot and shares as image/png, with a graceful web toast fallback.
